Knollrise: 2 directions

Make me a font like the contour lines on a hiking map. - **What is it for?** A word or two at poster size: a trail sign, a park poster, a race bib, a map cover, the title of a hiking guide. It works from about 100 px up. It is not for running text. (I chose this.) - **How should it feel?** Like a printed trail map: calm, exact, outdoors. From far away it reads as a heavy round word on a soft tint. Up close each letter is a small hill, with its rings and a summit mark. (I chose this, from the request.) - **What must it not look like?** A neon sign, a striped retro face with even stripes, a fingerprint, or a pattern that hides the letter. (I chose this.) - **Which styles?** One style in each of two families. Knollrise is the color family, with four palettes: Trail, Sea Chart, Night and Desert. Knollrise Lines is the same rings in one color. A color font has no variable file. (I chose this.)
